requirements.summary: Add app-ads.txt file to frontend/public/ with AdMob publisher ID for canonical URL verification
acceptanceCriteria: File `frontend/public/app-ads.txt` exists and is served at the app root URL (e.g., https://blockverse-9ge.caffeine.xyz/app-ads.txt)
File contains exactly: `google.com, pub-7936595519986908, DIRECT, f08c47fec0942fa0`
No other changes to existing files are required

file_operations.description: Create app-ads.txt file containing the AdMob publisher verification line 'google.com, pub-7936595519986908, DIRECT, f08c47fec0942fa0'. This file will be automatically served at the root URL path by the static file server, allowing AdMob to verify ownership of the application domain.
